trigger_condition: JSON roster with 1001 rows reaches Pydantic max_length
guard_snippet: if len(rows) > 1000: raise BATCH_TOO_LARGE(413) before model validation
potential_consequence: Framework returns 422 instead of contractual 413

trigger_condition: JSON roster with empty rows array
guard_snippet: if len(rows) == 0: raise BATCH_EMPTY(400) before model validation
potential_consequence: Framework returns 422 instead of contractual 400

trigger_condition: Revoke drop_reason empty or above 280 code points
guard_snippet: if not 1 <= len(drop_reason) <= 280: raise MALFORMED_DROP_REASON(400)
potential_consequence: Framework 422 replaces contractual 400 MALFORMED_DROP_REASON

trigger_condition: Authorize body missing user_id or action
guard_snippet: if 'user_id' not in body or 'action' not in body: return 400 ErrorBody (code pending G9-06)
potential_consequence: Framework 422 bypasses the 400 default fixed by G9-06

trigger_condition: JSON roster body omits subject_id echo field
guard_snippet: if body.get('subject_id') != path_subject_id: raise MALFORMED_BATCH(400)
potential_consequence: Framework 422 instead of MALFORMED_BATCH 400

trigger_condition: Batch term matches pattern but differs from subject term
guard_snippet: if term != subject.term: raise MALFORMED_TERM(400)
potential_consequence: Batch lands in wrong term or gets ambiguous 404

trigger_condition: Email has several @ or a subdomain of universidad.edu
guard_snippet: if email.count('@') != 1 or email.split('@')[1] != 'universidad.edu': row ROSTER_VALIDATION_FAILED
potential_consequence: Malformed or subdomain emails accepted or rejected inconsistently

trigger_condition: Two rows in one batch share email with different institutional_id
guard_snippet: if email.lower() in seen_emails: manifest row ROSTER_VALIDATION_FAILED
potential_consequence: DB UNIQUE error escapes as unmapped failure

trigger_condition: institutional_id exists with a different email or name
guard_snippet: if existing.email != row.email: manifest row ROSTER_VALIDATION_FAILED, no update
potential_consequence: Silent identity overwrite or unmapped UNIQUE conflict

trigger_condition: Batch IDs differing only by letter case
guard_snippet: if row.institutional_id.upper() in seen_upper: manifest row ROSTER_VALIDATION_FAILED
potential_consequence: Two identities created for one person

trigger_condition: drop_reason made only of invisible format characters
guard_snippet: if all(unicodedata.category(c) in ('Zs','Cf','Cc') for c in drop_reason): raise MALFORMED_DROP_REASON(400)
potential_consequence: Invisible-only reason accepted into audit ledger

trigger_condition: drop_reason contains control characters such as NUL
guard_snippet: if any(unicodedata.category(c) == 'Cc' for c in drop_reason): raise MALFORMED_DROP_REASON(400)
potential_consequence: Control characters corrupt log lines and CSV manifests

trigger_condition: Drop timestamp later than request_now
guard_snippet: if ts > request_now: raise MALFORMED_DROP_TIMESTAMP(400) # propuesta a confirmar
potential_consequence: Future academic drop dates persisted as truth

trigger_condition: Internal resolve called with at equal to null
guard_snippet: if at is None: raise INVALID_AT(400)
potential_consequence: Null instant reaches domain; AD-13 contradicts signature

trigger_condition: granted_at or expires_at stored with mixed fraction widths
potential_consequence: Text comparison misorders instants; interval invariant breaks

trigger_condition: ACTIVE ticket past expires_at still blocks a new ticket
guard_snippet: run expiry sweep before insert; reject with 409 only if expires_at > now
potential_consequence: Expired ticket blocks new escalation until next sweep

trigger_condition: Empty or blank email string accepted
guard_snippet: if not email.strip(): raise ROSTER_VALIDATION_FAILED for that row
potential_consequence: Blank identity emails persisted, breaking lookups

trigger_condition: Authentication lookup by key_hash with per-row salt
guard_snippet: CREATE INDEX idx_credentials_prefix ON subject_credentials(key_prefix, status); verify SHA-256(salt||raw) after prefix match
potential_consequence: key_hash index unusable; full scan on every authorize

trigger_condition: Batch CSV header preceded by a UTF-8 BOM
guard_snippet: if raw.startswith(b'\xef\xbb\xbf'): raise MALFORMED_BATCH(400) unless BOM is explicitly stripped
potential_consequence: Valid spreadsheet export rejected as MALFORMED_BATCH

trigger_condition: CSV multipart row contains a quoted field with a comma
guard_snippet: parse with csv module strict mode; field count must equal 4
potential_consequence: Column shift yields false MALFORMED_BATCH or wrong data

trigger_condition: Request Content-Type text/csv instead of multipart
guard_snippet: if content_type not in {'application/json', 'multipart/form-data'}: raise MALFORMED_BATCH(400)
potential_consequence: No defined status or code for unsupported media type

trigger_condition: Multipart request with two file parts
guard_snippet: if len(file_parts) != 1: raise MALFORMED_BATCH(400)
potential_consequence: Ambiguous batch source; one file silently chosen

trigger_condition: Identity SUSPENDED or COMPLETED with same role in batch
guard_snippet: if status in ('SUSPENDED','COMPLETED') and same_role: count unchanged, no reactivation
potential_consequence: Suspended membership reactivated or counted as updated

trigger_condition: Authorize action is an empty string
guard_snippet: if not action.strip(): raise 400 ErrorBody (code pending G9-06)
potential_consequence: Empty action reaches matrix with unclear verdict

trigger_condition: Role ta on CS-480 has no matrix row
guard_snippet: if (subject, role, action) not in rows: return DENY UNAUTHORIZED_RESOURCE_CLASS
potential_consequence: EDGE-01 TA context always denied; independence untestable

trigger_condition: audit_ledger_metadata row updated outside LedgerWriter
guard_snippet: CREATE TRIGGER trg_metadata_guard BEFORE UPDATE ON audit_ledger_metadata WHEN NEW.total_events_count <> OLD.total_events_count + 1 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'anchor-step'); END
potential_consequence: Anchor rewritten; tail truncation undetected in verification

trigger_condition: System clock moves backwards between scheduler sweeps
guard_snippet: if now < last_sweep_now: log WARN and hold expiry decisions
potential_consequence: Tickets expire late or granted_at appears in future

trigger_condition: roster.rejected accepted in queue, then process crashes
guard_snippet: persist ledger row synchronously before returning 422
potential_consequence: Client sees 422 while no audit event persisted

trigger_condition: Client retries roster after a lost 201 response
guard_snippet: if content_hash in committed_batches: return previous batch_id
potential_consequence: Duplicate batch and doubled audit trail

trigger_condition: Scheduler sweep cannot reserve queue space
guard_snippet: skip sweep and retry next second with WARN metric
potential_consequence: Expiry events delayed while queue is saturated
